<div class="card-body">
'''The Force Is Strong With This One''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">フォースの強いやつだ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ルークと能力値＞2の帝国軍が同じ戦闘に参加していれば使用できる。戦闘運命数を1回引いて加える（相手がベイダーなら2回）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-116o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">デス・スターのトレンチ内での追撃戦では、ルークの操縦技術とフォースの強さにより、ダース・ベイダーでさえ彼のXウイングに狙いを定めるのは困難だった。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Force is strong with this one.

'''Card text:''' If Luke and an Imperial of ability > 2 are in the same battle, add one battle destiny (two if the opponent is Vader).

'''Lore:''' In the Death Star trench, Luke's piloting and the Force made even Darth Vader's shots on his X-wing hard to place.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds two destiny if the opponent is Vader; the English does so if the Imperial is Vader.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[The Force Is Strong With This One]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
